britzl/gooey

Defold GUI system

  • GitHub: britzl/gooey — pinned to 10.5.3
    1. Pick a release from britzl/gooey releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

vertical_scrollbar(handle_id: Hash | string, bounds_id: Hash | string, action_id: Hash | undefined, action: Partial<go.on_input.Action>, fn: (scrollbar: ScrollbarState) => void, refresh_fn?: (scrollbar: ScrollbarState) => void, unused?: undefined): ScrollbarState

gooey.lua hands its fifth argument to gooey/internal/scrollbar.lua's M.vertical as the scroll callback and its sixth as the refresh callback, so the README's (handle_id, bounds_id, action_id, action, fn, refresh_fn) is the call that works; the seventh parameter gooey.lua names reaches nothing.

  • keyboard_type: number — Keyboard type to use (from gui.KEYBOARD_TYPE_*)

  • config?: { max_length?: number; empty_text?: string; allowed_characters?: string; use_marked_text?: boolean; } — Optional config table. Accepted values
    • empty_text (string) - Text to show when the field is empty
    • max_length (number) - Maximum number of characters that can be entered
